001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamconverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
009import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
010import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
011import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
012import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
013import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.io.InputStream;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import org.slf4j.Logger;

020/**
021 * Real-world data processing examples using StreamConverter.
022 *
023 * <p>This class demonstrates practical use cases including: - Data extraction from various formats
024 * - Data transformation pipelines - Format conversion workflows - Performance optimization
025 * techniques
026 */
027public class DataProcessingExamples {
028
029  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DataProcessingExamples.class);
030
031  /**
032   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。実用的なデータ処理例を実行します。
033   *
034   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
035   */
036  public static void main(String[] args) {
037    logger.info("🚀 StreamConverter - Real-world Examples");
038    logger.info("=========================================\n");
039
040    try {
041      // Example 1: Employee data processing
042      employeeDataProcessing();
043
044      // Example 2: API response processing
045      apiResponseProcessing();
046
047      // Example 3: Configuration file processing
048      configurationProcessing();
049
050      // Example 4: Log analysis
051      logAnalysis();
052
053      // Example 5: Data format conversion
054      dataFormatConversion();
055
056    } catch (Exception e) {
057      logger.error("Example failed: " + e.getMessage());
058      e.printStackTrace();
059    }
060  }
061
062  /** Example 1: Processing employee data from CSV format */
063  private static void employeeDataProcessing() throws IOException {
064    logger.info("👥 Employee Data Processing");
065    logger.info("============================");
066
067    String employeeData =
068        """
069        employee_id,name,department,salary,location
070        E001,John Smith,Engineering,75000,New York
071        E002,Jane Doe,Marketing,65000,Los Angeles
072        E003,Bob Johnson,Engineering,80000,Chicago
073        E004,Alice Brown,HR,60000,Houston
074        E005,Charlie Wilson,Engineering,70000,Seattle
075        """;
076
077    // Extract employee names for a directory
078    logger.info("📋 Extract employee names:");
079    processData(
080        employeeData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()));
081
082    // Extract salary information for budget analysis
083    logger.info("\n💰 Extract salary information:");
084    processData(
085        employeeData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("salary"), new PassThroughRule()));
086
087    // Extract department information for organization chart
088    logger.info("\n🏢 Extract department information:");
089    processData(
090        employeeData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("department"), new PassThroughRule()));
091
092    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
093  }
094
095  /** Example 2: Processing API response data */
096  private static void apiResponseProcessing() throws IOException {
097    logger.info("🌐 API Response Processing");
098    logger.info("===========================");
099
100    String apiResponse =
101        """
102        {
103          "status": "success",
104          "data": {
105            "users": [
106              {"id": 1, "name": "John", "email": "john@example.com", "active": true},
107              {"id": 2, "name": "Jane", "email": "jane@example.com", "active": false}
108            ],
109            "pagination": {
110              "total": 2,
111              "page": 1,
112              "per_page": 10
113            }
114          }
115        }
116        """;
117
118    // Extract status for monitoring
119    logger.info("📊 Extract API status:");
120    processData(
121        apiResponse, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("status"), new PassThroughRule()));
122
123    // Extract user data for processing
124    logger.info("\n👤 Extract user data:");
125    processData(
126        apiResponse, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("data"), new PassThroughRule()));
127
128    // Format entire response for logging (using root selector)
129    logger.info("\n📝 Format entire response:");
130    processData(
131        apiResponse, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson("$"), new PassThroughRule()));
132
133    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
134  }
135
136  /** Example 3: Configuration file processing */
137  private static void configurationProcessing() throws IOException {
138    logger.info("⚙️ Configuration Processing");
139    logger.info("============================");
140
141    String configXml =
142        """
143        <?xml version="1.0"?>
144        <configuration>
145          <database>
146            <host>localhost</host>
147            <port>5432</port>
148            <name>myapp</name>
149          </database>
150          <server>
151            <port>8080</port>
152            <ssl>true</ssl>
153          </server>
154          <logging>
155            <level>INFO</level>
156            <file>app.log</file>
157          </logging>
158        </configuration>
159        """;
160
161    // Extract database configuration
162    logger.info("🗄️ Extract database configuration:");
163    processData(
164        configXml,
165        XmlNavigateCommand.create(
166            TreePath.fromXml("configuration/database"), new PassThroughRule()));
167
168    // Extract server configuration
169    logger.info("\n🖥️ Extract server configuration:");
170    processData(
171        configXml,
172        XmlNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("configuration/server"), new PassThroughRule()));
173
174    // Extract logging configuration
175    logger.info("\n📊 Extract logging configuration:");
176    processData(
177        configXml,
178        XmlNavigateCommand.create(
179            TreePath.fromXml("configuration/logging"), new PassThroughRule()));
180
181    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
182  }
183
184  /** Example 4: Log analysis workflow */
185  private static void logAnalysis() throws IOException {
186    logger.info("📈 Log Analysis Workflow");
187    logger.info("=========================");
188
189    String logData =
190        """
191        timestamp,level,service,message
192        2023-07-15T10:30:00Z,INFO,auth-service,User login successful
193        2023-07-15T10:31:00Z,ERROR,payment-service,Payment processing failed
194        2023-07-15T10:32:00Z,WARN,auth-service,Rate limit exceeded
195        2023-07-15T10:33:00Z,INFO,order-service,Order placed successfully
196        """;
197
198    // Create analysis pipeline
199    IStreamCommand[] analysisPipeline = {
200      CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("level"), new PassThroughRule()), // Extract log levels
201      new SampleStreamCommand("level-analyzer") // Analyze log levels
202    };
203
204    logger.info("🔍 Log level analysis:");
205    processData(logData, analysisPipeline);
206
207    // Service-specific analysis
208    logger.info("\n🔧 Service analysis:");
209    processData(logData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("service"), new PassThroughRule()));
210
211    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
212  }
213
214  /** Example 5: Data format conversion */
215  private static void dataFormatConversion() throws IOException {
216    logger.info("🔄 Data Format Conversion");
217    logger.info("==========================");
218
219    String productData =
220        """
221        product_id,name,price,category
222        P001,Laptop,999.99,Electronics
223        P002,Chair,149.99,Furniture
224        P003,Book,29.99,Education
225        """;
226
227    // Multi-stage conversion pipeline
228    IStreamCommand[] conversionPipeline = {
229      CsvNavigateCommand.create(
230          new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()), // Extract product names
231      new SampleStreamCommand("name-processor"), // Process names
232      new SampleStreamCommand("format-converter") // Convert format
233    };
234
235    logger.info("🛍️ Product name conversion pipeline:");
236    processData(productData, conversionPipeline);
237
238    // Price extraction for financial analysis
239    logger.info("\n💲 Price extraction:");
240    processData(
241        productData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("price"), new PassThroughRule()));
242
243    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
244  }
245
246  /** Helper method to process data with given commands */
247  private static void processData(String inputData, IStreamCommand command) throws IOException {
248    processData(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
249  }
250
251  /** Helper method to process data with command pipeline */
252  private static void processData(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands) throws IOException {
253    try (InputStream inputStream =
254            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
255        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
256
257      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
258      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
259
260      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
261      logger.info("Output:");
262      logger.info(result.trim());
263    }
264  }
265}
